item.title: Painted City 1.3
item.description:
Boats and ships in the water are drawn as boats, with masts on sailing ships, never as buildings.

Quays stay level up to the water, and buses cross bridges level instead of dipping to the water (outside Sweden's survey data, roofs are taken out of the height data).

The menu: tap the place's name to change it, and turn the view with a compass right under it. The buttons at the bottom say what they do.

New install: paste one line into Terminal (see the release page).
